mapper.select: /* IResidentBoardNoticeMapper.selectResidentBoardNoticeDetail */ SELECT aabp.ann_no , aabp.board_no , abi.apt_cmplex_no , aabp.ttl , aabp.cn , aabp.wrtr_id , TO_CHAR(aabp.reg_dttm, 'YYYY-MM-DD') reg_dttm , TO_CHAR(aabp.mdf_dttm, 'YYYY-MM-DD') mdf_dttm , NVL(aabp.inq_cnt, 0) inq_cnt , aabp.del_yn , aabp.atch_file_id , abi.board_ty_cd , abi.board_nm , aabp.top_fix_yn FROM apt_ann_board_post aabp INNER JOIN apt_board_instance abi ON aabp.board_no = abi.board_no WHERE aabp.del_yn = 'N' AND abi.use_yn = 'Y' AND abi.board_ty_cd = 'NOTICE' AND abi.apt_cmplex_no = #{aptCmplexNo} AND aabp.ann_no = #{annNo}
